  815   var asset = $('gwAsset'), net = $('gwNet'),
  816       bc = $('gwCrypto'), bk = $('gwCard'), bn = $('gwNp'), bh = $('gwHp'),
  817       pv = $('gwPrev'), pvI = $('gwPvIcon'), pvN = $('gwPvName'), pvS = $('gwPvSub'), pvV = $('gwPvVal');
  818 
  819   function kind() {
  820     var r = form.querySelector('input[name="kind"]:checked');
  821     return r ? r.value : 'crypto';
  822   }
  823 
  824   function paintKind() {
  825     var k = kind();
  826     $$('.gw-kind').forEach(function (l) { l.classList.toggle('on', l.getAttribute('data-k') === k); });
  827     if (bc) bc.style.display = k === 'crypto' ? '' : 'none';
  828     if (bk) bk.style.display = k === 'card' ? '' : 'none';
  829     if (bn) bn.style.display = k === 'nowpay' ? '' : 'none';
  830     if (bh) bh.style.display = k === 'hooshpay' ? '' : 'none';
  831     paintPrev();
  832   }
  833 
  834   function paintNets() {
  835     if (!asset || !net) return;
  836     var a = asset.value, first = null;
  837     [].forEach.call(net.options, function (o) {
  838       var ok = o.getAttribute('data-asset') === a;
  839       o.hidden = !ok;
  840       o.disabled = !ok;
  841       if (ok && first === null) first = o;
  842     });
  843     if (net.selectedOptions.length && net.selectedOptions[0].disabled && first) first.selected = true;
  844     paintPrev();
  845   }
  846 
  847   function paintPrev() {
  848     if (!pv) return;
  849     var k = kind(),
  850         lb = ($('gwLabel') && $('gwLabel').value.trim()) || '',
  851         ic = ($('gwIcon') && $('gwIcon').value.trim()) || '',
  852         ak = asset ? asset.value : 'USDT',
  853         nt = (net && net.selectedOptions.length) ? net.selectedOptions[0].textContent.trim() : '',
  854         fee = parseFloat(($('gwFee') && $('gwFee').value) || '0') || 0,
  855         col = k === 'card' ? '#3b82f6' : (k === 'nowpay' ? '#8b5cf6' : (k === 'hooshpay' ? '#f59e0b' : (COLORS[ak] || '#22c55e'))),
  856         val = '—';
  857 
  858     if (k === 'crypto') val = ($('gwAddr') && $('gwAddr').value.trim()) || '—';
  859     if (k === 'card')   val = ($('gwNum') && $('gwNum').value.trim()) || '—';
  860     if (k === 'nowpay') val = 'NOWPayments';
  861     if (k === 'hooshpay') val = 'HooshPay';
  862 
  863     pv.style.setProperty('--c', col);
  864     if (pvI) pvI.textContent = ic || (k === 'card' ? '💳' : (k === 'nowpay' ? '⚡️' : '🌐'));
  865     if (pvN) pvN.textContent = lb || (k === 'crypto' ? (ak + (nt ? ' • ' + nt : '')) : KIND_T[k]);
  866     if (pvS) {
  867       var sub = KIND_T[k];
  868       if (k === 'crypto' && nt) sub += ' • ' + nt;
  869       if (fee) sub += ' • ' + (fee > 0 ? 'کارمزد ' : 'تخفیف ') + Math.abs(fee) + '٪';
  870       pvS.textContent = sub;
  871     }
  872     if (pvV) pvV.textContent = val.length > 26 ? (val.slice(0, 14) + '…' + val.slice(-8)) : val;
  873   }
  874 
  875   $$('input[name="kind"]', form).forEach(function (r) { r.addEventListener('change', paintKind); });
  876   if (asset) asset.addEventListener('change', paintNets);
